entities.summary: Janez Kozinc is a Slovenian Roman Catholic prelate, who has served as the bishop of the Diocese of Murska Sobota since 14 September 2025. He is the third bishop of the diocese, which forms part of the Archdiocese of Maribor within the Catholic Church in Slovenia.
